entries.relational_slices_section: SQL adapter and compatibility wrapper removal
entries.current_evidence: Application parity fixtures are freshness-checked and classified through the SQL adapter integration suite, and SQL/API durable-state coverage enumerates catalog and row-state syntax families.
entries.missing_evidence: Every PostgreSQL-shaped syntax path that can affect relational catalog or row state still needs release-gated classification as a golden typed plan, adapter-only no-op, or explicit unsupported shape naming the missing native feature.
entries.evidence_symbol: postgres sql adapter classifies fixture-backed application parity corpus

entries.relational_slices_section: SQL adapter and compatibility wrapper removal
entries.current_evidence: Catalog-backed read plans execute across source schemas and stale-catalog fixture coverage rejects invalid catalog references before runtime execution.
entries.missing_evidence: Each runtime statement and native migration step still needs binding against Antfly catalog snapshots before planning, with fail-closed behavior for stale or ambiguous catalog references across DDL, DML, and read paths.
entries.evidence_symbol: postgres sql adapter catalog-backed read plans execute across source schemas

entries.relational_slices_section: SQL adapter and compatibility wrapper removal
entries.current_evidence: Compatibility wrapper and parser migration inventories enumerate parser, binder, planner, and runtime wrapper classes with typed parser, binder, plan, runtime, parity, and state-safety evidence required before deletion.
entries.missing_evidence: Legacy string-only compatibility wrappers still need to be removed one at a time behind the recorded parser, binder, plan, runtime, and parity evidence.

entries.relational_slices_section: SQL adapter and compatibility wrapper removal
entries.current_evidence: Generated DML metadata rejection tests already fail closed for stale aliases, generated names, returning metadata, conflict targets, and generated CTE-prefix payloads.
entries.missing_evidence: Placeholders, aliases, table targets, generated names, and conflict targets still need structural normalization everywhere instead of SQL string scans.
entries.evidence_symbol: sql adapter lower dml rejects stale generated returning alias metadata
